capabilities: Check broken wiki-links and structural vault findings
Search and explore notes by semantic similarity
Prepare and apply supported note actions
Review Markdown flashcards with FSRS scheduling
Generate flashcards and style suggestions with optional AI
extras: 2.4.0 release candidate; Studio recipes and the Excalidraw diagram generator are not current entry points. Optional Companion integration; no built-in telemetry.
problem: Obsidian users lack a single place to check broken links, find related notes by meaning, and review flashcards.

relations.evidence: local Ollama or a remote provider

summary: Vault health and semantic search toolkit with note actions and FSRS flashcard review, using optional local or remote AI.
